headline: US Removes South Africa From AGOA Duty-Free Benefits
summary: The US government announced that South Africa will be removed from the duty-free benefits of the African Growth and Opportunity Act (Agoa) starting next year.
why: AGOA provides eligible sub-Saharan African nations with duty-free access to the US market, making its removal a significant trade constraint for South African exporters.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Loss of duty-free trade access to the US under AGOA negatively impacts South African export competitiveness.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Excluding South Africa from AGOA tariff exemptions increases export costs for local industries trading with the United States.
